items.title: TCU football heads to Tucson for Friday night showdown
items.summary: The Frogs will play at No. 22 Arizona for their only Friday night game of the season. Arizona is the second of four ranked teams TCU has scheduled this year.

items.title: Chance Named to Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List
items.summary: Amidst a stellar season, TCU punter John Hoyet Chance has been named to the Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List, the Augusta Sports Council announced Thursday.

items.title: Big 12 TV Partners Designate Kansas State for Six-Day Selection Window
items.summary: Kickoff time and network for TCU's matchup with Kansas State on November 14th will be set following this weekend's slate of games, the Big 12 announced Monday.

items.title: TCU comes back to beat Kansas 22-16

items.title: Carroll's Pick Six, Timely QB Runs Lead Frogs Past Kansas
